skill.summary: add video files into music-enhanced videos with this skill. Works with MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB. YouTubers use it for adding royalty-free music...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the YouTube Audio Library skill: add royalty-free music to your videos.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 videos with background music in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple upload, match, and export workflow optimized for YouTube creators.
- Seamless cloud processing; no need to handle technical details or backend steps manually.
- Includes interactive prompts, usage tips, and live status updates during video processing.
